topic: Which space a queued task reads and writes
detail: SP-011 resolves a task's process to its live run (task ID, directory, session) from the process tree; a reported orch-task-id only marks a caller as a task. No feature decides a task's space (the dispatching session's pin, the placement of its cwd, or a space named at dispatch), and a task whose run orchd is not tracking (a verification run, a run in another worker) has no record and so resolves to no space. Decide before SP-025 enforces reads.
note: Settled by the user on 2026-11-10: the dispatcher's space; see D-46 and SP-025.1.a8.
